reasoning: 驗證目標：清單顯示中，使用者請求 Page Up 或 Page Down 時，HU 以「一次一頁」的粒度更新顯示。關鍵情境條件：清單項目數多於兩頁，否則分頁粒度與捲動粒度不可區分。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 的驗證對象是更新粒度（一次一頁，對照 040 的一次一列），兩個方向各一次請求即可觀察，依 §5.7 併為一條 TC；整頁項目替換的確切語意與首末端 wrap-around 由兄弟 leaf 044/045 覆蓋。刻意略過：末頁項目不足一頁時的呈現不在 4872499 文字內，未生成。

tcs.tc_title: Page request updates the list one page at a time
tcs.test_item: When a list of items is being displayed and the user selects the Page Up or Page Down function the HU will update the display page of items at a time
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. A Tuner Station List holding more items than fit on two pages is displayed
5. The displayed rows start at a position in the middle of the list
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the items displayed and their order
2. Request the Page Down function once
3. Read the items displayed
4. Request the Page Up function once
5. Read the items displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. A full page of list items is displayed
2. The page request is accepted
3. A different block of list items is displayed and none of the items from step 1 remains on the page
4. The page request is accepted
5. The items displayed in step 1 are displayed again in the same order
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
